evidence.quote: the active ingredients list included in the labeling does not match the active ingredient list included in the electronic listing file.
are not properly listed with the FDA, causing them to be misbranded drugs under section 502(o) of the FD&C Act

affected_work.value: Media Networks Sydney의 Mylanta 2go Antacid Double Strength와 Microlax Enema의 FDA 전자 의약품 목록 및 제품 라벨 성분 정보가 대상입니다.

evidence.quote: This letter concerns your firm’s drug listing information provided to FDA’s electronic Drug Registration and Listing System (eDRLS) for the following drug products:
1 84177-0801 Mylanta 2go Antacid Double Strength 84177-0020 Microlax Enema

recommendation.value: FDA는 위반 원인을 조사해 신속히 시정하고 제품을 준수 상태로 만들며, 유통하는 다른 제품의 목록 결함도 바로잡으라고 요구합니다. 서신 수령 후 15근무일 이내에 취한 조치와 재발 방지 단계 및 관련 자료를 서면으로 제출해야 합니다.

evidence.quote: Your firm should investigate and determine the causes of any violations and take prompt actions to correct the violations and bring the products into compliance. It is also your responsibility to correct listing deficiencies with all other products distributed by your firm.

Please notify FDA in writing, within 15 working days of receipt of this letter, of the specific steps you have taken to address any violations. Include an explanation of each step being taken to prevent the recurrence of violations, as well as copies of related documentation.

response_deadline.value: within 15 working days of receipt of this letter
